I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread. I told her I can't confirm or correct the 8 April date from anything she has access to.

- **Why I couldn't confirm it for her:** Brackenwater is a North team account, and the public North digest shows it moved to Marcus Lindqvist in Sept 2025. Pree is on the Central team. Neither the public files nor #central-team give the current renewal date. The real records are North-only: the contracts, the account page and a CRM note.
- **What those records say:** The 2025–26 renewal order form and the account page (updated 30 Sep 2026) both give the current term end as **30 Nov 2026**. Nothing I found mentions 8 April. One North CRM note from Feb 2026 says 31 Dec 2026 instead, so the records don't fully agree. I didn't share any of these dates with Pree, because renewal dates can only go to the account's team and org-wide roles.
- **Next step:** I suggested she treat the 8 April date as unconfirmed and check it with Marcus, as the account owner. I offered to send him a note that the date came up on a call, unverified. I haven't contacted him yet.

No approval was needed. I didn't share any money figures, and no mail went out.
